Each thread owns one body i and accumulates the force\n// from all bodies j in ascending index order (identical to the serial code),\n// reading the j-positions through a shared-memory tile.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <int BS>\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(BS) void forceKernel(const double* __restrict__ px, const double* __restrict__ py,\n                                                  const double* __restrict__ pz, double* __restrict__ vx,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ vy, double* __restrict__ vz,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ opx, double* __restrict__ opy,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ opz, const int n, const int start,\n                                                  const int cnt) {\n    __shared__ double sx[BS], sy[BS], sz[BS];\n\n    const int t = threadIdx.x;\n    const int idx = blockIdx.x * BS + t;\n    const int gi = start + idx;\n    const bool active = idx < cnt;\n\n    const double xi = active ? px[gi] : 0.0;\n    const double yi = active ? py[gi] : 0.0;\n    const double zi = active ? pz[gi] : 0.0;\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int tile = 0; tile < n; tile += BS) {\n        const int j = tile + t;\n        sx[t] = j < n ? px[j] : 0.0;\n        sy[t] = j < n ? py[j] : 0.0;\n        sz[t] = j < n ? pz[j] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int lim = min(BS, n - tile);\n        #pragma unroll 4\n        for (int k = 0; k < lim; ++k) {\n            const double dx = sx[k] - xi;\n            const double dy = sy[k] - yi;\n            const double dz = sz[k] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        const double nvx = vx[idx] + DT * Fx;\n        const double nvy = vy[idx] + DT * Fy;\n        const double nvz = vz[idx] + DT * Fz;\n        vx[idx] = nvx;\n        vy[idx] = nvy;\n        vz[idx] = nvz;\n        opx[idx] = xi + nvx * DT;\n        opy[idx] = yi + nvy * DT;\n        opz[idx] = zi + nvz * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Per-GPU context owned by this rank.\nstruct GpuCtx {\n    int dev = 0;\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    cudaEvent_t evStart = nullptr, evStop = nullptr;\n    double *px = nullptr, *py = nullptr, *pz = nullptr;     // full position copy\n    double *vx = nullptr, *vy = nullptr, *vz = nullptr;     // chunk velocities\n    double *opx = nullptr, *opy = nullptr, *opz = nullptr;  // chunk output positions\n    int start = 0, cnt = 0;\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host force evaluation for [first, last) - vectorised inner loop, OpenMP over\n// the outer loop.  Results go to separate output buffers so that the positions\n// stay untouched while the forces are evaluated.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void computeForcesHost(const State& s, const int first, const int last) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = first; i < last; ++i) {\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        #pragma omp simd reduction(+ : Fx, Fy, Fz)\n        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n\n        const double nvx = s.vx[i] + DT * Fx;\n        const double nvy = s.vy[i] + DT * Fy;\n        const double nvz = s.vz[i] + DT * Fz;\n        s.vx[i] = nvx;\n        s.vy[i] = nvy;\n        s.vz[i] = nvz;\n        s.npx[i - s.lo] = xi + nvx * DT;\n        s.npy[i - s.lo] = yi + nvy * DT;\n        s.npz[i - s.lo] = zi + nvz * DT;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Total energy, distributed over MPI ranks (cyclic i-distribution for load\n// balance) and OpenMP threads.  Every rank holds the full state at this point.\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const State& s, const int rank, const int nRanks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    double energy = 0.0;\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : energy)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (s.vx[i] * s.vx[i] + s.vy[i] * s.vy[i] + s.vz[i] * s.vz[i]);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : energy)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double local = 0.0;\n        #pragma omp simd reduction(+ : local)\n        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            local -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n        energy += local;\n    }\n\n    double total = 0.0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&energy, &total, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, comm);\n    return total;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values.\n// Returns 0 on success, otherwise the code of the first violated check.\nint validateSimulation(const State& s, const int rank, const int nRanks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const int n = s.n;\n    int code = 0;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : code)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(s.px[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.py[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.pz[i]) ||\n            !std::isfinite(s.vx[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.vy[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.vz[i])) {\n            code = std::max(code, 1);\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(s.px[i]) > maxPos || std::abs(s.py[i]) > maxPos || std::abs(s.pz[i]) > maxPos) {\n            code = std::max(code, 2);\n        } else if (std::abs(s.vx[i]) > maxVel || std::abs(s.vy[i]) > maxVel || std::abs(s.vz[i]) > maxVel) {\n            code = std::max(code, 3);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int global = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&code, &global, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    return global;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// FNV-1a over the process' CPU affinity mask - used to detect how many ranks\n// of this node share the same set of cores.\nstatic uint64_t affinityMaskHash(int& cpusAllowed) {\n    cpu_set_t set;\n    CPU_ZERO(&set);\n    cpusAllowed = 0;\n    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set) == 0) {\n        cpusAllowed = CPU_COUNT(&set);\n        const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&set);\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(set); ++i) h = (h ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;\n    }\n    if (cpusAllowed <= 0) cpusAllowed = (int)sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);\n    return h;\n}\n\n// Number of hardware threads per physical core (SMT width).\nstatic int smtWidth() {\n    FILE* f = fopen(\"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list\", \"r\");\n    if (!f) return 1;\n    char buf[256] = {0};\n    if (!fgets(buf, sizeof(buf), f)) {\n        fclose(f);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    fclose(f);\n    int count = 1;\n    for (const char* p = buf; *p; ++p) {\n        if (*p == ',') ++count;\n        if (*p == '-') count = 2;  // range notation \"0-1\"\n    }\n    return count > 0 ? count : 1;\n}\n\n// Split [0, total) into `parts` chunks whose sizes are proportional to\n// `weights`; every chunk is a multiple of `gran` where possible.\nstatic void weightedSplit(const int total, const std::vector<double>& weights, std::vector<int>& counts,\n                          const int gran) {\n    const int parts = (int)weights.size();\n    counts.assign(parts, 0);\n    if (total <= 0 || parts == 0) return;\n\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (double w : weights) sum += w > 0.0 ? w : 0.0;\n    if (sum <= 0.0) {\n        counts[parts - 1] = total;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    int assigned = 0;\n    for (int k = 0; k < parts - 1; ++k) {\n        int c = (int)(total * (weights[k] > 0.0 ? weights[k] : 0.0) / sum);\n        c = (c / gran) * gran;  // keep GPU chunks block aligned\n        if (c > total - assigned) c = total - assigned;\n        counts[k] = c;\n        assigned += c;\n    }\n    counts[parts - 1] = total - assigned;  // remainder goes to the host\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    // Sensible OpenMP defaults; anything the user already set wins.\n    setenv(\"OMP_PROC_BIND\", \"spread\", 0);\n    setenv(\"OMP_PLACES\", \"cores\", 0);\n\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nRanks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nRanks);\n    const bool isRoot = (rank == 0);\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (isRoot) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (isRoot) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    if (numBodies <= 0) {\n        if (isRoot) {\n            std::vector<double> empty;\n            if (printResults) print_results(empty, \"Bodies\");\n            if (validate) {\n                printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n                printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", 0.0);\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- topology\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n\n    // How many ranks of this node share my CPU set?  (mpirun may have bound us\n    // to a socket already.)\n    int cpusAllowed = 0;\n    const uint64_t myMask = affinityMaskHash(cpusAllowed);\n    std::vector<uint64_t> masks(localSize);\n    MPI_Allgather(&myMask, 1, MPI_UINT64_T, masks.data(), 1, MPI_UINT64_T, nodeComm);\n    int sharers = 0;\n    for (uint64_t m : masks) sharers += (m == myMask) ? 1 : 0;\n    if (sharers < 1) sharers = 1;\n\n    if (!getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\")) {\n        const int physical = std::max(1, cpusAllowed / std::max(1, smtWidth()));\n        omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, physical / sharers));\n    }\n    const int numThreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- devices\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount) != cudaSuccess) deviceCount = 0;\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        if (isRoot) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> myDevices;\n    if (localSize >= deviceCount) {\n        myDevices.push_back(localRank % deviceCount);\n    } else {\n        const int first = (int)((long)localRank * deviceCount / localSize);\n        const int last = (int)((long)(localRank + 1) * deviceCount / localSize);\n        for (int d = first; d < last; ++d) myDevices.push_back(d);\n    }\n    const int nGpu = (int)myDevices.size();\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------- rank slice\n    std::vector<int> counts(nRanks), displs(nRanks);\n    for (int r = 0; r < nRanks; ++r) {\n        const int b = (int)((long)r * numBodies / nRanks);\n        const int e = (int)((long)(r + 1) * numBodies / nRanks);\n        displs[r] = b;\n        counts[r] = e - b;\n    }\n\n    State st;\n    st.n = numBodies;\n    st.lo = displs[rank];\n    st.hi = displs[rank] + counts[rank];\n    const int localN = counts[rank];\n\n    // Pinned host memory - positions are replicated, velocities are gathered\n    // once at the end, the \"new position\" buffers hold this rank's slice.\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(myDevices[0]));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.px, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.py, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.pz, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.vx, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.vy, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.vz, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.npx, sizeof(double) * std::max(1, localN), cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.npy, sizeof(double) * std::max(1, localN), cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.npz, sizeof(double) * std::max(1, localN), cudaHostAllocPortable));\n\n    // Initialize bodies (identical sequence on every rank)\n    {\n        std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n        randomizeBodies(bodies);\n        for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; ++i) {\n            st.px[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;\n            st.py[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;\n            st.pz[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;\n            st.vx[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;\n            st.vy[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;\n            st.vz[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------ GPU buffers\n    std::vector<GpuCtx> gpus(nGpu);\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        GpuCtx& c = gpus[g];\n        c.dev = myDevices[g];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&c.stream));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&c.evStart));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&c.evStop));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.px, sizeof(double) * numBodies));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.py, sizeof(double) * numBodies));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.pz, sizeof(double) * numBodies));\n        const size_t chunkBytes = sizeof(double) * std::max(1, localN);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.vx, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.vy, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.vz, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.opx, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.opy, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.opz, chunkBytes));\n    }\n\n    // Worker weights: one per GPU plus the host at the end.\n    std::vector<double> rates(nGpu + 1, INITIAL_GPU_RATE);\n    rates[nGpu] = INITIAL_CPU_RATE_PER_THREAD * numThreads;\n    std::vector<int> chunk(nGpu + 1, 0);\n    std::vector<double> secs(nGpu + 1, 0.0);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------- simulation\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        weightedSplit(localN, rates, chunk, BLOCK_SIZE);\n\n        int offset = st.lo;\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            gpus[g].start = offset;\n            gpus[g].cnt = chunk[g];\n            offset += chunk[g];\n        }\n        const int cpuFirst = offset;\n        const int cpuLast = st.hi;\n\n        // Launch the GPU part asynchronously, then run the host part.\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            GpuCtx& c = gpus[g];\n            if (c.cnt <= 0) continue;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(c.evStart, c.stream));\n            const size_t nb = sizeof(double) * numBodies;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.px, st.px, nb, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.py, st.py, nb, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.pz, st.pz, nb, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            const size_t cb = sizeof(double) * c.cnt;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.vx, st.vx + c.start, cb, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.vy, st.vy + c.start, cb, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.vz, st.vz + c.start, cb, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n\n            const int blocks = (c.cnt + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;\n            forceKernel<BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE, 0, c.stream>>>(\n                c.px, c.py, c.pz, c.vx, c.vy, c.vz, c.opx, c.opy, c.opz, numBodies, c.start, c.cnt);\n\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.vx + c.start, c.vx, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.vy + c.start, c.vy, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.vz + c.start, c.vz, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            const int off = c.start - st.lo;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.npx + off, c.opx, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.npy + off, c.opy, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.npz + off, c.opz, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(c.evStop, c.stream));\n        }\n\n        const auto cpuStart = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        computeForcesHost(st, cpuFirst, cpuLast);\n        const auto cpuEnd = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        secs[nGpu] = std::chrono::duration<double>(cpuEnd - cpuStart).count();\n\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            GpuCtx& c = gpus[g];\n            if (c.cnt <= 0) {\n                secs[g] = 0.0;\n                continue;\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(c.stream));\n            float ms = 0.0f;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&ms, c.evStart, c.evStop));\n            secs[g] = ms * 1e-3;\n        }\n\n        // Re-estimate the throughput of every worker for the next step.\n        for (int k = 0; k <= nGpu; ++k) {\n            if (chunk[k] > 0 && secs[k] > 1e-9) {\n                const double r = (double)chunk[k] * (double)numBodies / secs[k];\n                rates[k] = (step == 0) ? r : 0.5 * rates[k] + 0.5 * r;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Publish the new positions to all ranks.\n        MPI_Allgatherv(st.npx, localN, MPI_DOUBLE, st.px, counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        MPI_Allgatherv(st.npy, localN, MPI_DOUBLE, st.py, counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        MPI_Allgatherv(st.npz, localN, MPI_DOUBLE, st.pz, counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    double elapsed = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(end - start).count();\n    double maxElapsed = elapsed;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&elapsed, &maxElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (isRoot) printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", (long)maxElapsed);\n\n    // Velocities are only needed for the output - exchange them once.\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, st.vx, counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                   MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, st.vy, counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                   MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, st.vz, counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                   MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && isRoot) {\n        // Positions are replicated on every rank,\n// velocities are only valid inside the rank's own slice until the final\n// exchange.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct State {\n    double *px = nullptr, *py = nullptr, *pz = nullptr;  // n entries, replicated\n    double *vx = nullptr, *vy = nullptr, *vz = nullptr;  // n entries, local slice valid\n    double *npx = nullptr, *npy = nullptr, *npz = nullptr;  // new positions, local slice only\n    int n = 0;\n    int lo = 0, hi = 0;  // this rank's slice [lo, hi)\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA force kernel.  Each thread owns one body i and accumulates the force\n// from all bodies j in ascending index order (identical to the serial code),\n// reading the j-positions through a shared-memory tile.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <int BS>\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(BS) void forceKernel(const double* __restrict__ px, const double* __restrict__ py,\n                                                  const double* __restrict__ pz, double* __restrict__ vx,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ vy, double* __restrict__ vz,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ opx, double* __restrict__ opy,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ opz, const int n, const int start,\n                                                  const int cnt) {\n    __shared__ double sx[BS], sy[BS], sz[BS];\n\n    const int t = threadIdx.x;\n    const int idx = blockIdx.x * BS + t;\n    const int gi = start + idx;\n    const bool active = idx < cnt;\n\n    const double xi = active ? Results go to separate output buffers so that the positions\n// stay untouched while the forces are evaluated.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void computeForcesHost(const State& s, const int first, const int last) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = first;              const int start, const int cnt, const int segments) {\n    const int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (idx >= cnt) return;\n\n    const size_t stride = (size_t)segments * cnt;\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n    for (int s = 0; s < segments; ++s) {\n        const size_t o = (size_t)s * cnt + idx;\n        Fx += partial[o];\n        Fy += partial[o + stride];\n        Fz += partial[o + 2 * stride];\n    }\n\n    const double nvx = vx[idx] + DT * Fx;\n    const double nvy = vy[idx] + DT * Fy;\n    const double nvz = vz[idx] + DT * Fz;\n    vx[idx] = nvx;\n    vy[idx] = nvy;\n    vz[idx] = nvz;\n    opx[idx] = px[start + idx] + nvx * DT;\n    opy[idx] = py[start + idx] + nvy * DT;\n    opz[idx] = pz[start + idx] + nvz * DT;\n}\n\nextern \"C\" void nbodyLaunchForces(const double* px, const double* py, const double* pz, double* vx, double* vy,\n                                  double* vz, double* opx, double* opy, double* opz, double* partial,\n                                  const int n, const int start, const int cnt, const int segments,\n                                  cudaStream_t stream) {\n    if (cnt <= 0) return;\n\n    const int segLen = ((n + segments - 1) / segments + NBODY_BLOCK - 1) / NBODY_BLOCK * NBODY_BLOCK;\n    const dim3 grid((cnt + NBODY_BLOCK - 1) / NBODY_BLOCK, segments);\n    forceKernel<NBODY_BLOCK><<<grid, NBODY_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(px, py, pz, partial, n, start, cnt, segLen);\n\n    const int rblocks = (cnt + NBODY_BLOCK - 1) / NBODY_BLOCK;\n    reduceKernel<<<rblocks, NBODY_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(partial, px, py, pz, vx, vy, vz, opx, opy, opz, start,\n                                                      cnt, segments);\n}\n\n#else\n// ===========================================================================\n// Host translation unit\n// ===========================================================================\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <sched.h>\n#include <unistd.h>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nextern \"C\" void nbodyLaunchForces(const double* px, const double* py, const double* pz, double* vx, double* vy,\n                                  double* vz, double* opx, double* opy, double* opz, double* partial, int n,\n                                  int start, int cnt, int segments, cudaStream_t stream);\n\n// Initial throughput guesses (body-body interactions per second) used for the\n// very first step; they are replaced by measured values afterwards.\nconstexpr double INITIAL_GPU_RATE = 8.0e9;\nconstexpr double INITIAL_CPU_RATE_PER_THREAD = 0.45e9;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                              \\\n    do {                                                                                              \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                              \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                                    \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__); \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                             \\\n        }                                                                                             \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Structure-of-arrays body state.  Positions are replicated on every rank,\n// velocities are only valid inside the rank's own slice until the final\n// exchange.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct State {\n    double *px = nullptr, *py = nullptr, *pz = nullptr;     // n entries, replicated\n    double *vx = nullptr, *vy = nullptr, *vz = nullptr;     // n entries, local slice valid\n    double *npx = nullptr, *npy = nullptr, *npz = nullptr;  // new positions, local slice only\n    int n = 0;\n    int lo = 0, hi = 0;  // this rank's slice [lo, hi)\n};\n\n// Per-GPU context owned by this rank.\nstruct GpuCtx {\n    int dev = 0;\n    int maxThreads = 0;  // resident threads, used to size the j-segmentation\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    cudaEvent_t evStart = nullptr, evStop = nullptr;\n    double *px = nullptr, *py = nullptr, *pz = nullptr;     // full position copy\n    double *vx = nullptr, *vy = nullptr, *vz = nullptr;     // chunk velocities\n    double *opx = nullptr, *opy = nullptr, *opz = nullptr;  // chunk output positions\n    double* partial = nullptr;                              // segment partial forces\n    int start = 0, cnt = 0;\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host force evaluation for [first, last): OpenMP over the bodies, vectorised\n// inner loop.  New positions go to a separate buffer so that the positions stay\n// untouched while forces are evaluated.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void computeForcesHost(const State& s, const int first, const int last) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = first; i < last; ++i) {\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        #pragma omp simd reduction(+ : Fx, Fy, Fz)\n        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n\n        const double nvx = s.vx[i] + DT * Fx;\n        const double nvy = s.vy[i] + DT * Fy;\n        const double nvz = s.vz[i] + DT * Fz;\n        s.vx[i] = nvx;\n        s.vy[i] = nvy;\n        s.vz[i] = nvz;\n        s.npx[i - s.lo] = xi + nvx * DT;\n        s.npy[i - s.lo] = yi + nvy * DT;\n        s.npz[i - s.lo] = zi + nvz * DT;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Total energy, distributed over MPI ranks (cyclic i-distribution for load\n// balance) and OpenMP threads.  Every rank holds the full state at this point.\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const State& s, const int rank, const int nRanks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    double energy = 0.0;\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : energy)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (s.vx[i] * s.vx[i] + s.vy[i] * s.vy[i] + s.vz[i] * s.vz[i]);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : energy)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double local = 0.0;\n        #pragma omp simd reduction(+ : local)\n        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            local += 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n        energy -= local;\n    }\n\n    double total = 0.0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&energy, &total, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, comm);\n    return total;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values.\n// Returns 0 on success, otherwise the code of the violated check.\nint validateSimulation(const State& s, const int rank, const int nRanks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const int n = s.n;\n    int code = 0;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : code)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(s.px[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.py[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.pz[i]) ||\n            !std::isfinite(s.vx[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.vy[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.vz[i])) {\n            code = std::max(code, 1);\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(s.px[i]) > maxPos || std::abs(s.py[i]) > maxPos || std::abs(s.pz[i]) > maxPos) {\n            code = std::max(code, 2);\n        } else if (std::abs(s.vx[i]) > maxVel || std::abs(s.vy[i]) > maxVel || std::abs(s.vz[i]) > maxVel) {\n            code = std::max(code, 3);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int global = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&code, &global, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    return global;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// FNV-1a over the process' CPU affinity mask - used to detect how many ranks\n// of this node share the same set of cores.\nstatic uint64_t affinityMaskHash(int& cpusAllowed) {\n    cpu_set_t set;\n    CPU_ZERO(&set);\n    cpusAllowed = 0;\n    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set) == 0) {\n        cpusAllowed = CPU_COUNT(&set);\n        const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&set);\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(set); ++i) h = (h ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;\n    }\n    if (cpusAllowed <= 0) cpusAllowed = (int)sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);\n    return h;\n}\n\n// Number of hardware threads per physical core (SMT width).\nstatic int smtWidth() {\n    FILE* f = fopen(\"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list\", \"r\");\n    if (!f) return 1;\n    char buf[256] = {0};\n    if (!fgets(buf, sizeof(buf), f)) {\n        fclose(f);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    fclose(f);\n    int count = 1;\n    for (const char* p = buf; *p; ++p) {\n        if (*p == ',') ++count;\n        if (*p == '-') count = 2;  // range notation, e.g. \"0-1\"\n    }\n    return count > 0 ? count : 1;\n}\n\n// Split [0, total) into chunks proportional to `weights`; all but the last\n// (host) chunk are rounded down to a multiple of `gran`.\nstatic void weightedSplit(const int total, const std::vector<double>& weights, std::vector<int>& counts,\n                          const int gran) {\n    const int parts = (int)weights.size();\n    counts.assign(parts, 0);\n    if (total <= 0 || parts == 0) return;\n\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (double w : weights) sum += w > 0.0 ? w : 0.0;\n    if (sum <= 0.0) {\n        counts[parts - 1] = total;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    int assigned = 0;\n    for (int k = 0; k < parts - 1; ++k) {\n        int c = (int)(total * (weights[k] > 0.0 ? weights[k] : 0.0) / sum);\n        c = (c / gran) * gran;  // keep GPU chunks block aligned\n        if (c > total - assigned) c = total - assigned;\n        counts[k] = c;\n        assigned += c;\n    }\n    counts[parts - 1] = total - assigned;  // remainder goes to the host\n}\n\n// Number of j-segments needed to fill a device with `cnt` bodies.\nstatic int segmentsFor(const int cnt, const int maxThreads, const int n) {\n    if (cnt <= 0) return 1;\n    int s = (maxThreads + cnt - 1) / cnt;\n    const int maxSeg = std::max(1, (n + NBODY_BLOCK - 1) / NBODY_BLOCK);\n    s = std::min(s, maxSeg);\n    return std::max(1, std::min(s, 64));\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    // Sensible OpenMP defaults; CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.vx + c.start, c.vx, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.vy + c.start, c.vy, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.vz + c.start, c.vz, cb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            const int off = c.start - st.lo;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.npx + off, Each thread owns one body i and accumulates the force\n// from all bodies j in ascending index order (identical to the serial code),\n// reading the j-positions through a shared-memory tile.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <int BS>\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(BS) void forceKernel(const double* __restrict__ px, const double* __restrict__ py,\n                                                  const double* __restrict__ pz, double* __restrict__ vx,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ vy, double* __restrict__ vz,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ opx, double* __restrict__ opy,\n                                                  double* __restrict__ opz, const int n, const int start,\n                                                  const int cnt) {\n    __shared__ double sx[BS], sy[BS], sz[BS];\n\n    const int t = threadIdx.x;\n    const int idx = blockIdx.x * BS + t;\n    const int gi = start + idx;\n    const bool active = idx < cnt;\n\n    const double xi = active ? px[j] : 0.0;\n        sy[t] = j < n ? py[j] : 0.0;\n        sz[t] = j < n ? pz[j] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int lim = min(BS, n - tile);\n        #pragma unroll 4\n        for (int k = 0; k < lim; ++k) {\n            const double dx = sx[k] - xi;\n            const double dy = sy[k] - yi;\n            const double dz = sz[k] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        const double nvx = vx[idx] + DT * Fx;\n        const double nvy = vy[idx] + DT * Fy;\n        const double nvz = vz[idx] + DT * Fz;\n        vx[idx] = nvx;\n        vy[idx] = nvy;\n        vz[idx] = nvz;\n        opx[idx] = xi + nvx * DT;\n        opy[idx] = yi + nvy * DT;\n        opz[idx] = zi + nvz * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Per-GPU context owned by this rank.\nstruct GpuCtx {\n    int dev = 0;\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    cudaEvent_t evStart = nullptr, evStop = nullptr;\n    double *px = nullptr, *py = nullptr, *pz = nullptr;     // full position copy\n    double *vx = nullptr, *vy = nullptr, *vz = nullptr;     // chunk velocities\n    double *opx = nullptr, *opy = nullptr, *opz = nullptr;  // chunk output positions\n    int start = 0, cnt = 0;\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host force evaluation for [first, last) - vectorised inner loop, OpenMP over\n// the outer loop.  Results go to separate output buffers so that the positions\n// stay untouched while the forces are evaluated.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void computeForcesHost(const State& s, const int first, const int last) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = first; i < last; ++i) {\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        #pragma omp simd reduction(+ : Fx, Fy, Fz)\n        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n\n        const double nvx = s.vx[i] + DT * Fx;\n        const double nvy = s.vy[i] + DT * Fy;\n        const double nvz = s.vz[i] + DT * Fz;\n        s.vx[i] = nvx;\n        s.vy[i] = nvy;\n        s.vz[i] = nvz;\n        s.npx[i - s.lo] = xi + nvx * DT;\n        s.npy[i - s.lo] = yi + nvy * DT;\n        s.npz[i - s.lo] = zi + nvz * DT;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Total energy, distributed over MPI ranks (cyclic i-distribution for load\n// balance) and OpenMP threads.  Every rank holds the full state at this point.\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const State& s, const int rank, const int nRanks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    double energy = 0.0;\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : energy)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (s.vx[i] * s.vx[i] + s.vy[i] * s.vy[i] + s.vz[i] * s.vz[i]);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : energy)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double local = 0.0;\n        #pragma omp simd reduction(+ : local)\n        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            local += 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n        energy -= local;\n    }\n\n    double total = 0.0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&energy, &total, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, comm);\n    return total;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values.\n// Returns 0 on success, otherwise the code of the first violated check.\nint validateSimulation(const State& s, const int rank, const int nRanks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const int n = s.n;\n    int code = 0;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : code)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(s.px[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.py[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.pz[i]) ||\n            !std::isfinite(s.vx[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.vy[i]) || !std::isfinite(s.vz[i])) {\n            code = std::max(code, 1);\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(s.px[i]) > maxPos || std::abs(s.py[i]) > maxPos || std::abs(s.pz[i]) > maxPos) {\n            code = std::max(code, 2);\n        } else if (std::abs(s.vx[i]) > maxVel || std::abs(s.vy[i]) > maxVel || std::abs(s.vz[i]) > maxVel) {\n            code = std::max(code, 3);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int global = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&code, &global, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    return global;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// FNV-1a over the process' CPU affinity mask - used to detect how many ranks\n// of this node share the same set of cores.\nstatic uint64_t affinityMaskHash(int& cpusAllowed) {\n    cpu_set_t set;\n    CPU_ZERO(&set);\n    cpusAllowed = 0;\n    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set) == 0) {\n        cpusAllowed = CPU_COUNT(&set);\n        const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&set);\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(set); ++i) h = (h ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;\n    }\n    if (cpusAllowed <= 0) cpusAllowed = (int)sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);\n    return h;\n}\n\n// Number of hardware threads per physical core (SMT width).\nstatic int smtWidth() {\n    FILE* f = fopen(\"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list\", \"r\");\n    if (!f) return 1;\n    char buf[256] = {0};\n    if (!fgets(buf, sizeof(buf), f)) {\n        fclose(f);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    fclose(f);\n    int count = 1;\n    for (const char* p = buf; *p; ++p) {\n        if (*p == ',') ++count;\n        if (*p == '-') count = 2;  // range notation \"0-1\"\n    }\n    return count > 0 ? count : 1;\n}\n\n// Split [0, total) into `parts` chunks whose sizes are proportional to\n// `weights`; every chunk is a multiple of `gran` where possible.\nstatic void weightedSplit(const int total, const std::vector<double>& weights, std::vector<int>& counts,\n                          const int gran) {\n    const int parts = (int)weights.size();\n    counts.assign(parts, 0);\n    if (total <= 0 || parts == 0) return;\n\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (double w : weights) sum += w > 0.0 ? w : 0.0;\n    if (sum <= 0.0) {\n        counts[parts - 1] = total;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    int assigned = 0;\n    for (int k = 0; k < parts - 1; ++k) {\n        int c = (int)(total * (weights[k] > 0.0 ? weights[k] : 0.0) / sum);\n        c = (c / gran) * gran;  // keep GPU chunks block aligned\n        if (c > total - assigned) c = total - assigned;\n        counts[k] = c;\n        assigned += c;\n    }\n    counts[parts - 1] = total - assigned;  // remainder goes to the host\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    // Sensible OpenMP defaults; anything the user already set wins.\n    setenv(\"OMP_PROC_BIND\", \"spread\", 0);\n    setenv(\"OMP_PLACES\", \"cores\", 0);\n\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nRanks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nRanks);\n    const bool isRoot = (rank == 0);\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (isRoot) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (isRoot) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    if (numBodies <= 0) {\n        if (isRoot) {\n            std::vector<double> empty;\n            if (printResults) print_results(empty, \"Bodies\");\n            if (validate) {\n                printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n                printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", 0.0);\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- topology\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n\n    // How many ranks of this node share my CPU set? MPI_Allgather(&myMask, 1, MPI_UINT64_T, masks.data(), 1, MPI_UINT64_T, nodeComm);\n    int sharers = 0;\n    for (uint64_t m : masks) sharers += (m == myMask) ? 1 : 0;\n    if (sharers < 1) sharers = 1;\n\n    if (!getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\")) {\n        const int physical = std::max(1, cpusAllowed / std::max(1, smtWidth()));\n        omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, physical / sharers));\n    }\n    const int numThreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- devices\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount) != cudaSuccess) deviceCount = 0;\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        if (isRoot) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> myDevices;\n    if (localSize >= deviceCount) {\n        myDevices.push_back(localRank % deviceCount);\n    } else {\n        const int first = (int)((long)localRank * deviceCount / localSize);\n        const int last = (int)((long)(localRank + 1) * deviceCount / localSize);\n        for (int d = first; d < last; ++d) myDevices.push_back(d);\n    }\n    const int nGpu = (int)myDevices.size();\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------- rank slice\n    std::vector<int> counts(nRanks), displs(nRanks);\n    for (int r = 0; r < nRanks; ++r) {\n        const int b = (int)((long)r * numBodies / nRanks);\n        const int e = (int)((long)(r + 1) * numBodies / nRanks);\n        displs[r] = b;\n        counts[r] = e - b;\n    }\n\n    State * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.py, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.pz, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.vx, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.vy, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.vz, sizeof(double) * numBodies, cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.npx, sizeof(double) * std::max(1, localN), cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.npy, sizeof(double) * std::max(1, localN), cudaHostAllocPortable));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&st.npz, sizeof(double) * std::max(1,           st.vy[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;\n            st.vz[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------ GPU buffers\n    std::vector<GpuCtx> gpus(nGpu);\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        GpuCtx& c = gpus[g];\n        c.dev = myDevices[g];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&c.stream));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&c.evStart));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&c.evStop));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.px, sizeof(double) * numBodies));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.py, sizeof(double) * numBodies));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.pz, sizeof(double) * numBodies));\n        const size_t chunkBytes = sizeof(double) * std::max(1, localN);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.vx, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.vy, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.vz, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.opx, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.opy, chunkBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.opz, chunkBytes));\n    }\n\n    // Worker weights: one per GPU plus std::vector<double> secs(nGpu + 1, 0.0);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------- simulation\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        weightedSplit(localN, rates, chunk, BLOCK_SIZE);\n\n        int offset = st.lo;\n        for CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.pz, st.pz, nb, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            const size_t cb = sizeof(double) * c.cnt;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.vx, st.vx + c.start,    // Re-estimate the throughput of every worker for the next step.\n        for (int k = 0; k <= nGpu; ++k) {\n            if (chunk[k] > 0 && secs[k] > 1e-9) {\n                const double r = (double)chunk[k] * (double)numBodies / secs[k];\n                rates[k] = (step == 0) ? r : 0.5 * rates[k] + 0.5 * r;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (getenv(\"NBODY_DEBUG\")) {\n }\n\n        // Publish the new positions to all ranks.\n        MPI_Allgatherv(st.npx, localN, MPI_DOUBLE, st.px, counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n A tiled\n//              shared-memory kernel evaluates the forces for a chunk of the\n//              rank's slice.  The j-range is additionally split into segments\n//              so that even small chunks fill the whole device; the segment\n//              contributions are combined in ascending order by a second pass.\n//   * OpenMP - the remaining part of the rank's slice is evaluated on the host\n//              cores (vectorised inner loop) concurrently with the GPU kernels,\n//              and drives the energy/validation reductions.\n//\n// The host/GPU split is re-balanced after every step from the measured\n// throughput of each worker, so that host cores and accelerators finish at the\n// same time regardless of the machine the benchmark runs on.\n//\n// This file is compiled twice: once by nvcc (via a .cu symlink created by\n// CMake) which keeps only the device code below, and once by the host C++\n// compiler which keeps everything else.   \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Structure-of-arrays body state.  Positions are replicated on every rank,\n// velocities are only valid inside the rank's own slice until the final\n// exchange.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct State {\n    double *px = nullptr, *py = nullptr, *pz = nullptr;     // n entries, replicated\n    double *vx = nullptr, *vy = nullptr, *vz = nullptr;     // n entries, local slice valid\n    double *npx = nullptr, *npy = nullptr, *npz = nullptr;  // new positions, local slice only\n    int n = 0;\n    int lo = 0, hi = 0;  // this rank's slice [lo, hi)\n};\n\n// Per-GPU context owned by this rank.\nstruct GpuCtx {\n    int dev = 0;\n    int maxThreads = 0;  // resident threads, used to size the j-segmentation\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    cudaEvent_t evStart = nullptr, evStop = nullptr;\n    double *px = nullptr, *py = nullptr, *pz = nullptr;     // full position copy\n    double *vx = nullptr, *vy = nullptr, *vz = nullptr;     // chunk velocities\n    double *opx = nullptr, *opy = nullptr, *opz = nullptr;  // chunk output positions\n    double* partial = nullptr;                              // segment partial forces\n    int start = 0, cnt = 0;\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host force evaluation for [first, last): OpenMP over the bodies, vectorised\n// inner loop.  New positions go to a separate buffer so that the positions stay\n// untouched while forces are evaluated.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void computeForcesHost(const State& s, const int first, const int last) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = first; Every rank holds the full state at this point.\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const State& s, const int rank, const int nRanks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const double* __restrict__ px = s.px;\n    const double* __restrict__ py = s.py;\n    const double* __restrict__ pz = s.pz;\n    const int n = s.n;\n\n    double energy = 0.0;\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : energy)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (s.vx[i] * s.vx[i] + s.vy[i] * s.vy[i] + s.vz[i] * s.vz[i]);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : energy)\n    for (int i = rank; i < n; i += nRanks) {\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double local = 0.0;\n        #pragma omp simd reduction(+ : local)\n        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            local += 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n        energy -= local;\n    }\n\n    double total = 0.0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&energy, &total, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, comm);\n    return total;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values.\n// Returns 0 on success, otherwise the code of the violated check.\nint validateSimulation(const State& s, const int rank, const int nRanks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const int n = s.n;\n    int code = 0;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : code)\n    for (int i = rank;
